integrity_statement: Proof uses an exact finite-state automaton, integer characteristic polynomial, and exact rational Perron/Sturm certificates; direct finite-word enumeration is independent corroboration rather than a proof of asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Only the second synchronous spatial image of Rule 110 on the bilateral full shift is classified; not the temporal entropy, all later images, the limit set, or any finite-ring ensemble. Full-text access to the 2017 Ruivo--de Oliveira follow-up was unavailable and complete historical priority is not certified.
title: Exact second-image entropy of synchronous Rule 110
